queries_run: Marriott International antitrust OR DOJ OR FTC OR regulatory scrutiny 2026

findings.claim: 英國 CMA 對 CoStar、Hilton、IHG、Marriott 展開調查，懷疑經由酒店數據服務商共享競爭敏感資訊，可能違反 Competition Act 1998 第 I 章；案件狀態 Open，2026-03-02 開案，2026-08-05 更新行政時程。
findings.source: UK CMA case page：Suspected anti-competitive conduct in relation to hotel accommodation services
findings.excerpt: The Competition and Markets Authority (CMA) is investigating the suspected sharing of competitively sensitive information

findings.claim: 10-K Item 3：EPA 就 Marriott 管理的一家酒店涉嫌違反 Clean Air Act 提出和解討論；公司認為不會有重大不利影響。
findings.excerpt: In the 2025 second quarter, we received a letter from the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (the “EPA”) offering to engage in settlement discussions in relation to violations of the Clean Air Act that the EPA alleges occurred at a hotel we manage.

regulatory_antitrust.note: 本軸搜尋結果未見 2026 年 DOJ/FTC 對 Marriott 的執法行動；FTC 對 CitizenM 收購的審查為 2025 年已通過。
